# 2 Chronicles Chapter 1 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-said Solomon son-of David and-he-strengthened-himself over his-kingdom and-YHWH his-God was with-him and-He-made-him-great exceedingly.

**2** And-he-said Solomon to-all Israel to-commanders-of the-thousands and-the-hundreds and-to-the-judges and-to-every leader to-all Israel heads-of the-fathers.

**3** And-they-went Solomon and-all the-assembly with-him to-the-high-place that was-in Gibeon for there was tent-of meeting-of God which made Moses servant-of YHWH in-the-wilderness.

**4** But ark-of God had-brought-up David from-Kiriath-jearim to-the-place-that prepared David for-it for he-pitched for-it a-tent in-Jerusalem.

**5** And-altar-of bronze that made Bezalel son-of Uri son-of Hur he-placed before tabernacle-of YHWH and-he-sought-him Solomon and-the-assembly.

**6** And-he-went-up Solomon there to-altar-of bronze before YHWH which was-at tent-of meeting and-he-offered upon-it burnt-offerings a-thousand.

**7** In-the-night that God appeared to-Solomon and-He-said to-him ask what I-shall-give to-you.

**8** And-he-said Solomon to-God You You-have-done with David my-father lovingkindness great and-You-have-made-me-king in-his-place.

**9** Now YHWH God let-be-confirmed Your-word with David my-father for You You-have-made-me-king over a-people many as-dust-of the-earth.

**10** Now wisdom and-knowledge give to-me and-I-will-go-out before this-people and-I-will-come-in for who can-judge this Your-people the-great.

**11** And-He-said God to-Solomon because that was this with your-heart and-not you-asked riches wealth and-honor and-life-of your-enemies and-also days many not you-asked but-you-asked for-yourself wisdom and-knowledge that you-may-judge My-people which I-made-you-king over-them

**12** the-wisdom and-the-knowledge is-given to-you and-riches and-wealth and-honor I-will-give to-you which not was so to-the-kings who were-before-you and-after-you not shall-be so.

**13** And-he-came Solomon from-the-high-place that was-in Gibeon from-before tent-of meeting to-Jerusalem and-he-reigned over Israel.

**14** And-he-gathered Solomon chariots and-horsemen and-he-had a-thousand and-four-hundreds chariots and-twelve thousand horsemen and-he-placed-them in-cities-of the-chariot and-with the-king in-Jerusalem.

**15** And-he-made the-king the-silver and-the-gold in-Jerusalem as-the-stones and-the-cedars he-made as-the-sycamores that are-in-the-Shephelah for-abundance.

**16** And-source-of the-horses that were-for-Solomon from-Egypt and-from-Kue merchants-of the-king from-Kue they-acquired at-a-price.

**17** And-they-brought-up and-they-brought-out from-Egypt a-chariot for-six hundreds silver and-a-horse for-a-hundred and-fifty and-so for-all kings-of the-Hittites and-kings-of Aram by-their-hand they-brought-out.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **1:7**: ask what I-shall-give — God's offer to Solomon parallels the divine testing pattern. The verb sha'al (ask) echoes 1 Samuel's wordplay on Saul's name.

- **1:10**: wisdom and-knowledge — Hebrew chokmah u-madda. The pairing is unique to Chronicles; Kings uses only chokmah. The Chronicler emphasizes comprehensive intellectual capacity.

- **1:15**: as-the-stones — Hyperbolic abundance language. Silver loses its value when it becomes as common as fieldstones.


— EMET
